title: Tell HN: Wise holds my company's $22,954 for 27 days, then goes silent
text:
Wise closed the business accounts of my Delaware LLC and of my Polish sole proprietorship. I am not appealing the closure. I only want the remaining balances back: USD 22,954.01 (LLC, held by Wise US Inc.) and PLN 3,415.82 (sole proprietorship, Wise Europe SA).

Timeline (2026): - 17 Sep: email from Wise: "We've closed your account. We're unable to share the specific reason why we're closing your account." - 21 Sep: Wise says "our decision to close these accounts is final" and asks for refund bank details. For the LLC it offers a payout in PLN to my Polish company account. - 22 Sep: I send the details; I send them again on 28 Sep. On 28 Sep Wise confirms it has received "all the details you provided". - 29 Sep: Wise writes that it holds the bank details and that nothing more is required from me. - 6 Oct: one agent asks me for a photo ID and a selfie with ID to start an "appeal" and says it cannot find an open complaint. - 7 Oct: a complaint reference is created. Another agent writes: "There is nothing further needed from you." and that I "should never have been asked to submit an appeal". - 8 Oct: "The manual balance refunds are being processed directly by our specialist team." Later the same day Support writes it has "exhausted all of our department options". - 11 Oct: the Complaints Team partially upholds my complaint and offers compensation for the customer-support failures. On the balances: "We are currently still conducting these checks on your remaining funds and are unable to provide an exact timeline for how long they may take." - 13 Oct: after my second request, the Complaints Team asks for different payout accounts (a personal account for the LLC instead of the Polish company account Wise itself proposed on 21 Sep; EUR instead of PLN for the sole proprietorship) and writes: "Once we have your confirmation, we will be able to start processing your refund." I confirm both accounts in writing the same day and ask for confirmation that the refunds are being processed. - 14 Oct: urgent reminder. No reply to any of my five emails since 13 Oct.

As of 14 Oct: 27 days since the closure, no payout, no payout date. Complaints filed today with Ombudsfin (Belgium) and the Delaware Office of the State Bank Commissioner.

Wise case ID: 26303051, complaint references: 50738608 and 50962286.

Has anyone got a refund from a closed Wise business account in a similar situation? How long did the "checks" take after you supplied the account details they asked for?
